scope: Correct the interpretation of the two counter operations recorded in R275 and R280.

correction.prior_wording: R280 described the R277 +3 step and the separate R279 five-step +3 sequence as 18 accumulated X counts.
correction.reason: mame_live_mouse clears each operation's counter overrides on completion and restores the live physical accumulator. The count values across these separate operations therefore cannot be summed into a proven cursor displacement.
correction.corrected_reading: R277 completed one +3 X counter step. R279 later completed a separate five-step sequence at +3 per step. Both finished with cleanups and no errors; the final R279 screenshot still did not show the pointer over a target. No arrow was pressed.

impact: Only the cumulative-count interpretation is withdrawn. VM identity/profile, screen visibility, no-arrow-press result, GTK2 state comparisons and 79% technical coverage estimate are unchanged.
